mapper.sql: id, code, product_name, batch_no, sample_type, priority, storage_condition, status, received_at, due_date, created_by, created_at, updated_at, conclusion, completed_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lab_sample (code, product_name, batch_no, sample_type, priority, storage_condition, status, received_at, due_date, created_by) VALUES (#{code}, #{productName}, #{batchNo}, #{sampleType}, #{priority}, #{storageCondition}, #{status}, #{receivedAt}, #{dueDate}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM lab_sample WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

where.if: (code COLLATE pg_c_utf8 ILIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '\' OR product_name COLLATE pg_c_utf8 ILIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '\' OR batch_no COLLATE pg_c_utf8 ILIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '\')
AND status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED') AND due_date < #{today}

mapper.sql: ORDER BY CASE priority WHEN 'URGENT' THEN 0 WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, received_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.select:
SELECT page.*, progress.approved_count, progress.effective_count FROM (SELECT FROM lab_sample
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}) page CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'APPROVED') AS approved_count, count(*) AS effective_count FROM test_result r WHERE r.sample_id = page.id AND r.status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED')) progress
SELECT status, count(*) AS count FROM lab_sample GROUP BY status

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED') AND due_date < #{today}) AS overdue_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE completed_at >= #{since}) AS completed_count, avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM completed_at - received_at)) FILTER (WHERE completed_at >= #{since}) AS avg_tat_seconds FROM lab_sample

SELECT FROM lab_sample WHERE status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED') AND (priority = 'URGENT' OR due_date < #{today}) ORDER BY due_date, CASE priority WHEN 'URGENT' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, received_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
